feedback: Pre-race review of the iteration 6 candidate. It returns base_speed to 1.1 and lowers kp from 2.5 to 2.0, with the narrow five-sensor array (x = 0.03, 0.015, 0, -0.015, -0.03), sensor_weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], kd 0.3, ki 0 and last_direction unchanged. Iteration 4 (base_speed 1.1, kp 2.5, kd 0.3) is the best raced design at 302.3, so this candidate is a clean single-variable change from it. Iteration 5 showed that lowering speed to 0.9 cut oval completion, so the speed is held at 1.1. Iteration 3 (kp 2.2 with kd 0.25 at base_speed 1.3) scored 106.7, but it changed kd as well and ran at a different speed, so it does not isolate the effect of kp. Iteration 2 showed that the wide array does not help line retention, so the geometry is kept. The candidate is valid: all values are within the contract limits and the sign convention is unchanged. Nothing about its performance can be read from the earlier races, so the race is the only real test. Next race, interpreted as follows. If line_loss_events on the oval and s-bend fall and oval completion holds at or above about 50%, keep kp 2.0 and test kd 0.25 alone. If line loss rises or max_error rises above about 0.06, the weaker kp is too slow to correct, so return to kp 2.5 and test base_speed 1.2 alone, since iteration 1 at 1.3 and iteration 4 at 1.1 are the only tested speeds near that range. If runs finish but completion_time exceeds 2.8 s, the speed cut is the problem, so hold base_speed at 1.1 and do not drop it further.
requested_changes: Keep the narrow geometry, base_speed 1.1, kd 0.3, ki 0 and last_direction from iteration 4, and change only kp to 2.0. Use the race to check whether line_loss_events and max_error fall on the oval and s-bend, and whether oval completion holds near or above 55%.

If line_loss_events rise or max_error exceeds about 0.06 with kp 2.0, return to kp 2.5 and test base_speed 1.2 alone, since iteration 4 at 1.1 and iteration 1 at 1.3 are the only controlled speed comparisons.
If line loss falls and completion holds with kp 2.0, test kd 0.25 alone in the next revision, since iteration 4 showed oval steering_oscillation of 0.33 at kd 0.3.
